featured_reviews.name: Vimal Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
The biggest issue is the deposit refund. The owner does not return the full deposit and creates unnecessary problems during the process. In my case, only around 60% of the deposit was returned, and the remaining amount was deducted without any clear or valid explanation. Charges were applied arbitrarily, which felt unfair.

I had to call more than 30 times just to get updates on my deposit, and many times the owner did not even pick up the calls. This made the whole process very frustrating and unprofessional.

Major suggestion: do not leave the PG until your full deposit is returned, as it becomes very difficult to recover the remaining amount later.

The PG had basic amenities and was manageable for staying, but there were several issues. Initially, there were problems with filtered water and the AC, which caused inconvenience. Although the owner fixed these after complaints, it took time and effort to get them resolved. Cleaning was done daily, which is a positive point, but there were still cockroaches in the kitchen, which was not hygienic.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Keshav
featured_reviews.review_text: Dhirubhai PG is not just about staying , it’s about living right. Prime Dadar location, excellent connectivity, clean and well-maintained rooms, peaceful surroundings, and a genuinely homely atmosphere that makes everyday life easier. The management is supportive, safety is well taken care of, and the overall vibe stays calm and respectful. People who live here understand the comfort, discipline, and convenience it offers. As for the haters , when a place does things right, noise is inevitable. Quality doesn’t argue, it simply exists. Those who know, know. ✨💯

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst girls PG in Dadar. Owner does not treat all girls equally and ignores complaints completely. Problems in the PG are never addressed. Waste of money and peace of mind.
I stayed here for 1 month and 15 days, and because of continuous problems, I left.

There is no discipline in this PG. Some girls constantly make loud calls to their family and friends, which disturbs others badly. A few girls regularly torture, harass, and create unnecessary disturbance. When we try to speak to them politely, they start fighting and abusing instead. Few girls calling their family, friends and sometimes boys which is totally banned in girls pg majorly creating problem and privacy issues of other girls.

I complained to the PG owner many times, but he took no real action. He kept giving fake hopes, saying that notice had been given, but nothing changed. The same girls continued creating problems. The owner does not listen to genuine complaints and fails to maintain a safe and peaceful environment.

Because of all these reasons, I left the PG. I would strongly not recommend this PG to any girl looking for a safe, calm, and respectful place to stay.

Owner is taking fake reviews. As i posted this review after that he is taking forcefully good reviews from anyone. Don't rely on this good rating.

featured_reviews.name: Salma Studio
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ghatiya - My experience at Dhiru PG was absolutely terrible. The condition of the rooms was unacceptable, and the hygiene standards were shockingly poor. The worst part was the severe bedbug problem it was impossible to sleep peacefully at night. I was constantly disturbed, uncomfortable, and frustrated due to the lack of basic cleanliness and maintenance.
Despite this being a fundamental issue, there seemed to be no proper action taken to resolve it. A place meant for living should at the very least ensure a clean and safe sleeping environment, and this PG completely failed in that regard.
I would strongly caution anyone considering this PG to thoroughly inspect the rooms before committing. What I experienced was far below even the most basic expectations.

2. Flat had everything installed including AC, beds, almirah, fans, 2 western bathrooms, fridge, induction, washing machine, water filter, geyser, wifi. No shortage of water or electricity supply.

3. One can also enjoy all the festivals at this prime location. Ganesh Chaturthi(Lalbaug is nearby), Janmashtami, Navratri,etc. It's really happening and vibrant in that part of Mumbai.

Cons:
1. One issue was of disturbance due to noise of trains especially in work from home, though one may get used to it. At a point one may even enjoy passing of trains.

2. Other issue might be of rats near building and a few times dirt/trash did came through window.

3. If you are bachelor, budget might be an issue

Overall it was a good experience.

featured_reviews.name: Alan K M
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 5 Stars of Disgrace – Seva Niketan

This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. The staff openly smoke, drink, and use weed in areas where they know there are no cameras. Rooms are never cleaned — they’re filthy, unhygienic, and the beds are infested with bed bugs.

The lady at the front desk seems more interested in picking fights than helping guests. They allow cops and GST officers to walk in at any hour, but paying guests are locked out if they return late. Even after taking your money, they won’t open the gate or show basic courtesy.

The bathrooms are always clogged and dirty, and the canteen is outright disgusting — you can see rats running around the kitchen. It’s shocking that a place run under Christian management treats guests with such disrespect and neglect.

To make things worse, they refuse to provide any proper proof of payment — no bills, no receipts, nothing.

A completely mismanaged, unhygienic, and unsafe place. Stay away.

featured_reviews.name: BubbleAisle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I usually don’t leave reviews, but I feel compelled to share my disappointing experience. First off, the customer service was incredibly lacking. The staff seemed uninterested and unhelpful, which made the entire experience feel very uncomfortable. I waited much longer than expected for my order, and when it finally arrived, it was cold and not at all what I had asked for.

The ambiance was nothing to write home about either. The place was poorly lit, and the decor felt outdated and drab. To make matters worse, the bathroom was dirty, and the overall cleanliness of the restaurant was far below acceptable standards.

I also found the pricing to be absurd for the quality of food and service I received. It’s clear that this place is not focused on its customers, and I won’t be returning. Definitely not worth the hype.

name: The Jain Education Society
description: The Jain Education Society (JES), Mumbai, founded in 1943 by Shri Chimanbhai Chakubhai Shah and Shri Durlabhjibhai Khetani, aimed to support bright students from Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Maharashtra in pursuing higher education. JES provided hostel accommodation, scholarships, and financial assistance, benefiting approximately 4,000 students. As a pre-independence charitable organization, JES has made significant contributions to Jain community education. It ran a Gujarati Medium School at Chirabazar, Mumbai, for over 30 years and currently operates three boys' hostels, a school in Rajkot, and various educational assistance programs. JES plays a vital role in nation-building by fostering educated, resourceful, and successful students
